LanguageData.HD_Hemostasis_Reduction: Bleeding reduction on this body part: {0}
LanguageData.HD_TCCC_MenuDesc: Hemostasis requires a charged medical pouch on worn body armor and treats up to six bleeding parts. It takes 5 seconds for up to three parts, then 5 more seconds per part, up to 20 seconds. Temporary pressure begins after two thirds of the work; completed dressings reduce local bleeding by 80% for 12 hours. Casualty tether attachment takes 1 second. Hemostasis, attachment and MIST each use one treatment charge. Analgesia requires a charged large pouch and gives one full dose: ketamine when breathing is below 70%, otherwise fentanyl. Addiction chance is reduced by 30%. A hemostatic agent requires separate stock in a large pouch and takes 1 second; it reduces systemic bleeding by 70% for 6 hours. MIST preparation takes 5 seconds.
LanguageData.HD_TCCC_NoPain: No additional analgesia is needed at the current pain level.
LanguageData.HD_TCCC_NoAnalgesic: Fentanyl or ketamine from Blanca's Drugs is unavailable. The companion drug module must be active.
LanguageData.HD_TCCC_CannotDrag: The casualty must be downed, adjacent and not already connected to another rescuer.
